num_vertices: <int> Total number of vertices in the graph.
num_edges: <int> Total number of edges in the graph.
vertices: <list[int], length num_vertices> Labels of all vertices in the graph.

edges.i: <int> First endpoint vertex of the edge.
edges.j: <int> Second endpoint vertex of the edge.
edges.weight: <int> Positive weight assigned to the edge.
